🏡 Stunning Home in Temple, TX – Full Tour!
Discover this gorgeous 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home located in the heart of Temple, TX! Built in 2020, this property feels like new with 2,045 sq. ft. of living space, a 3-car garage, and modern upgrades throughout.

The outdoor space is a showstopper, featuring a sparkling chlorine pool (added in 2021), a covered patio, and an extra concrete slab—perfect for entertaining. Inside, the kitchen shines with leathered granite countertops, custom cabinets, and a spacious island. The wood-beamed coffered ceiling in the living room adds an elegant touch, while ceramic wood-look tile flows through the main living areas.

Located in Belton ISD, this home offers convenient access to shopping, dining, and amenities in West Temple, TX. Plus, the solar panels will be completely paid off at closing, giving you the benefit of energy savings without any additional cost!
